  <section class="hero">
    <h2>Understanding DMT</h2>
    <p>
      DMT, or N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a powerful psychedelic substance.
      This page provides general educational information and does not
      promote purchasing, selling, manufacturing or illegal possession.
    </p>
  </section>

  <section class="section" id="overview">
    <h2>What Is DMT?</h2>

    <p>
      DMT is a psychedelic compound that can produce significant changes
      in perception, thought, mood and awareness. Its effects can vary
      considerably depending on the individual and circumstances.
    </p>

    <div class="cards">

      <div class="card">
        <h3>Perception</h3>
        <p>
          Some people report intense visual and sensory experiences,
          altered perception of time and unusual patterns or imagery.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="card">
        <h3>Psychological Effects</h3>
        <p>
          Experiences can include strong emotions, changes in thought
          patterns and altered awareness.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="card">
        <h3>Duration</h3>
        <p>
          The duration and intensity can vary depending on the route of
          administration and other factors.
        </p>
      </div>

    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="section" id="effects">
    <h2>Possible Effects</h2>

    <ul>
      <li>Altered visual perception</li>
      <li>Changes in perception of time</li>
      <li>Intense emotional experiences</li>
      <li>Confusion or disorientation</li>
      <li>Changes in awareness and thought</li>
      <li>Possible anxiety or panic</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

  <section class="section" id="risks">
    <h2>Potential Risks</h2>

    <div class="warning">
      <strong>Important:</strong>
      Psychedelic experiences can be unpredictable. Psychological
      distress, panic, impaired judgment and other adverse reactions
      can occur.
    </div>

    <p>
      Combining psychoactive substances can introduce additional risks.
      People with certain medical or psychological vulnerabilities may
      also face increased risks.
    </p>
  </section>

  <section class="section" id="safety">
    <h2>Safety & Harm Reduction</h2>

    <ul>
      <li>Avoid driving or operating machinery while impaired.</li>
      <li>Do not assume an unknown substance has a known composition.</li>
      <li>Avoid combining psychoactive substances.</li>
      <li>Seek professional medical advice when concerned about health effects.</li>
      <li>Keep potentially dangerous substances away from children and pets.</li>
      <li>Seek emergency medical assistance if someone becomes seriously unwell.</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

  <section class="section">
    <h2>DMT and the Law</h2>

    <p>
      Laws concerning DMT vary by country and jurisdiction and may change
      over time. Always consult current official laws and regulations in
      your location rather than relying on online advertisements or claims
      about legality.
    </p>
  </section>

    <h2>Getting Help</h2>

    <p>
      If DMT or another substance is causing problems with daily life,
      relationships or wellbeing, consider speaking with a qualified
      healthcare professional or substance-use service.
    </p>
